best_snapshot.selection: best 10-scene train-time val curve (epoch 155, val EPE 13.224878619783064)

ceiling: ARM D is a PROXY. It is evidence ONLY about driving-domain synthetic pretraining on 4400 pairs. It is NOT evidence about full SceneFlow pretraining, and ARM P remains BLOCKED/NOT RUN regardless of this outcome. A negative ARM D does NOT establish that SceneFlow pretraining fails: Driving is ~12% of the upstream corpus, single-domain, and the upstream recipe trains on FlyingThings3D + Monkaa + Driving together.

decision.direction: ARM D best is 5.0476991 px WORSE (higher EPE) than ARM K
decision.verdict: HURT -- Driving-domain synthetic pretraining hurt. The >= 1.0 px improvement did not occur; EPE moved the wrong way by a material margin (5x the bar).
